records.title: ToolMind Technical Report: A Large-Scale, Reasoning-Enhanced Tool-Use Dataset
records.reason: The main contribution is a large tool-use dataset and reasoning-enhanced training/evaluation; no serving or cache optimization is tested.

records.title: VideoZoomer: Reinforcement-Learned Temporal Focusing for Long Video Reasoning
records.reason: VideoZoomer learns temporal focus for long-video reasoning, but the primary text does not establish inference latency/memory savings and may add selection/tool overhead.

records.title: TROJail: Trajectory-Level Optimization for Multi-Turn Large Language Model Jailbreaks with Process Rewards
records.reason: TROJail optimizes jailbreak trajectories and process rewards for attack success, outside the inference-efficiency scope.

records.title: OmniGAIA: Towards Native Omni-Modal AI Agents
records.reason: OmniGAIA is primarily an omni-modal agent/model report and benchmark. Despite a serving-lineage association, its full text does not establish a concrete serving optimization or resource-efficiency method.

records.title: SCRIBE: Structured Mid-Level Supervision for Tool-Using Language Models
records.reason: The contribution is structured supervision for tool-use behavior and training/evaluation outcomes, not inference cache or serving performance.
